metaTitle: Watt-Hours vs mAh: Compare Battery Capacity
description: Learn how to convert mAh to watt-hours, account for conversion losses, and compare power banks with camping power stations before you buy.
directAnswer: Convert everything to watt-hours: multiply mAh by 3.7 volts and divide by 1,000. A 20,000 mAh power bank is about 74 Wh, and real delivered energy is typically 65 to 85 percent of that label.
